newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean offers mostly flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean offers mostly flat.

text.p: Nearby FOB grain and soybean basis values were mostly steady on Friday and movement was said to be quiet ahead of Tuesday's USDA monthly crop report, export sources said.
"Everybody is waiting on the USDA Tuesday," a broker said.
USDA was expected to raise its estimates for U.S. corn and soybean production. But brokers also anticipated an increase in usage figures, including a larger soybean export number.
Wheat basis values were steady but brokers noted some interest in news USDA and Turkey may be near an agreement on phytosanitary requirements.
USDA on Wednesday stopped issuing export certificates for grains and oilseeds to Turkey after Turkey enacted a zero-tolerance policy on the wheat fungus ergot.
Turkey on Friday relaxed the restriction, saying it would take levels of the fungus up to 0.05 percent. The disagreement could be resolved further as early as Monday.
Brokers said there was speculation that Turkey may tender for up to 500,000 tonnes U.S. wheat next week but were unable to confirm the talk.
